description: READ-ONLY. Amazon EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) report for one seller outpost and one CLOSED calendar period, from SP-API GET_EPR_MONTHLY_REPORTS / GET_EPR_QUARTERLY_REPORTS / GET_EPR_ANNUAL_REPORTS (Product Listing role, sellers only). Returns a summary per ship-to country and EPR category/subcategory: units sold, total reported weight (kg) and material weights (paper, glass, aluminum, steel, plastic, wood, other) as calculated by Amazon, the exact period written in the file (report_period_start/end), data-quality flags (rows without weight, category or registration number) and the top ASINs by weight. Use it to prepare or check an EPR declaration (packaging, WEEE, batteries) for a consultant or producer compliance scheme; it is support data, not a legal certification. Default: last closed month. Async: IN_PROGRESS is not zero; call again with the same arguments after retry_after_seconds (resumes the same report). CANCELLED = Amazon produced no EPR data for that period/marketplace, which does NOT mean there are no EPR obligations. EPR REGISTRATION NUMBERS cannot be uploaded or changed via any API: they are entered manually in Seller Central (EPR portal), per country and category; this tool only reads them back.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

country.description: Optional ship-to country filter, ISO 2 letters (DE, FR, ES…). Totals then cover only that country.

limit.description: How many top ASINs by reported weight to list, default 20. Summaries always cover all rows.

period.description: Closed period: YYYY-MM (monthly), YYYY-Qn e.g. 2026-Q2 (quarterly), YYYY (annual). Default: last closed period of that type. Current/future periods are rejected.

period_type.description: Aggregation of the Amazon report. Default monthly.

refresh.description: true = ask Amazon for a new report instead of reusing a ready one for the same period.

name: get_epr_report
